constraints.notes: Settlement Agreement caps: Average Daily Departures and annual Million Annual Passengers (MAP) are fixed by a 1985 settlement agreement (as renegotiated in 2014/2020), not by physical capacity. ADDs rise from 85 to 95 and the MAP cap rises from 10.8M to 12.5M on a phased schedule running through the agreement's expiration in 2030-2035 (curfew to 2035).
